raw.details:
Overview

AgentX is a national-level idea hackathon designed to challenge participants to imagine and design the AI agents of the future. Participants will take on the role of innovators and product thinkers to design practical AI agents that solve real problems and improve everyday life. No coding or building is required, just a clear, creative and practical idea.

Objective:

  • Encourage creative thinking around AI agents.
  • Develop problem-solving skills for real-world challenges.
  • Explore how AI agents can plan, use tools and take actions to reach goals.
  • Enhance strategic thinking, product ideation and presentation skills.
  • Promote responsible and human-centric AI innovation.

Eligibility:

  • Open to all undergraduate students.
  • Individual participation only.
  • No technical or coding background is required.

Competition Format:

  • Single-round idea hackathon.
  • Participants will receive a problem statement at the start of the competition.
  • Problem statements may cover areas such as:
    • Education and Learning
    • Healthcare
    • Campus Life
    • Careers and Jobs
    • Small Businesses
    • Smart Cities
    • Sustainable Living
    • Accessibility and Everyday AI
  • Participants will have 24 hours to analyze the problem statement and design an AI agent solution.
  • A detailed participant guide (PDF) with the presentation structure and evaluation criteria is available on this page.

Important Dates:

  • Registration Deadline: 5th December 2026, 6:00 PM
  • Competition Start: 5th December 2026, 6:00 PM
  • Submission Deadline: 6th December 2026, 10:00 PM

Submission Details:

  • Submission format: PPT or PDF (6-10 slides recommended).
  • Participants must clearly present:
    • Problem understanding
    • The AI agent idea
    • How the agent works, step by step
    • Tools, data and technologies involved
    • An example user scenario or workflow
    • Expected impact and feasibility
    • Risks and limitations
  • Optional mockup, storyboard or wireframe may be included.

Judging Criteria:

  • Originality of the idea: 25%
  • Real problem and usefulness: 25%
  • Clarity of how the agent works: 20%
  • Feasibility: 15%
  • Quality of presentation: 15%

Rules and Guidelines:

  • Individual participation only.
  • Original work is mandatory; plagiarism will result in disqualification.
  • AI tools are permitted; however, solutions must reflect the participant's own creativity, analysis and thinking.
  • Late submissions will not be accepted.
  • Participants must ensure clarity, practicality and proper justification of their idea.
  • The decision of the organizing team will be final and binding.
